primary_metric: withheld acceptance resolved without pass-to-pass regressions
difficulty: unlabeled; no independently established difficulty labels
hypothesis: Evaluate whether the predeclared visible-input router reduces requests while retaining repair success; no improvement is assumed.
interpretation: Three purposively selected defects across two held-out projects. Repeats are not new defects. Project-cluster intervals are descriptive; incomplete pairs do not establish a winner. Unknown usage and money remain null.
change_scope: Execution strategy only. Primary/reviewer profiles, retrieval budgets, Coder/Reviewer prompts, source permissions, visible tests and withheld acceptance remain fixed across arms. The single-Coder arm omits LLM planning/review by definition and still requires visible test and human approval gates. This does not isolate individual role effects.
output_limit_rationale: A generic complete-file JSON edit can exceed 4096 output tokens for an allowed 120KB source file. Choose 32768 before inference, equally for all Gemini roles/arms, without hidden-result tuning. ChatGPT supports only the existing local byte/time limit, not a server output-token cap.
